# SmartHomeScheduler

**Class:** `SmartHomeScheduler` · **Group:** [Module widgets — Smart Home](../Groups/Module-widgets-Smart-Home.md) · **Header:** [`SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeAdvancedWidgets.h`](../../../SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeAdvancedWidgets.h) · `#include "SmartHome/ui/UltraCanvasSmartHomeAdvancedWidgets.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Timed events by day, week or as a list

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasUIElement> CreateSmartHomeSchedulerElement();
```

Constructors:

```cpp
SmartHomeScheduler(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
SmartHomeScheduler(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit SmartHomeScheduler(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `SetOnEventSelected()` | `void SetOnEventSelected(std::function<void(const std::string&)> callback)` | Takes a callback. |
| `SetOnEventCreate()` | `void SetOnEventCreate(std::function<void(const std::string&, int)> callback)` | A press on an empty slot of the day or week grid: "HH:00" and the day (0 = Sunday). |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

### struct `TopologyViewNode`

@brief Network node for topology visualization Deliberately NOT called NetworkNode: ISmartHomeProtocol.h already declares a NetworkNode in this same namespace, describing the network rather than the view of it. Two structs of one name in one namespace is a redefinition error the moment a translation unit includes both headers — which is exactly what wiring this widget to a protocol backend does. This one carries view state (position, selection), so it is the one that got renamed.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `DeviceId` | `std::string DeviceId` |  |
| `Name` | `std::string Name` |  |
| `Protocol` | `SmartHomeProtocolType Protocol` |  |
| `State` | `SmartHomeDeviceState State` |  |
| `SignalStrength` | `int SignalStrength` | /&lt; RSSI or LQI |
| `Y` | `float X, Y` | /&lt; Position in view |
| `IsRouter` | `bool IsRouter` | /&lt; Router/coordinator role |
| `IsSelected` | `bool IsSelected` |  |
